name: How can I make a small guest bathroom feel more spacious?

mainEntity.name: How can I make a small guest bathroom feel more spacious?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can make a compact guest bath feel significantly larger by selecting visual-expanding fixtures, thoughtful lighting, and continuous surfaces. Installing a floating vanity reveals floor space beneath, which tricks the eye into seeing a larger room. Replacing a shower curtain with clear frameless glass allows sightlines to extend directly to the back wall. Using large-format wall tile with minimal grout lines also reduces visual clutter. Recessed lighting paired with a backlit mirror improves brightness across all corners without encroaching on overhead or wall space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a floating vanity, clear glass shower doors, large-format tile, and recessed lighting to eliminate visual barriers and open up the room.
